title: Register papyrus-threat-intelligence and papyrus-anth-us as Papyrus editor sites (R1)
description:
Ryan decided (2026-10-21, relayed by the Cyclotron session) that the central Cyclotron lab is the single classifier per publication, and editors on each Papyrus site add references through the lab via Prospectus-verified curation. That needs the threat-intelligence and anth.us Papyrus sites registered as editor sites, like papyrus-p-apyr-us and papyrus-pilobol-us.

Scope: add papyrus-threat-intelligence and papyrus-anth-us to accounts/papyrus-sites.json with each site's Cognito issuer and client ID, its Amplify compute role ARN, and its federation and site review IDs. Each site's role then gets the 8 site routes in the central API resource policy, so check the 8,192-character budget (4,824 used at last check, about 198 per site). Hand the site sessions (S2/S3) the value they need: the central API stage ARN for cms.prospectusAccountsApiStageArn in each site.json. Anth.us-web has no aws block yet.

Acceptance: both sites validate at startup; an editor signs in once at each site and enrollment resolves to the same Person; the Cyclotron lab verifier accepts their tokens. Deploy only with Ryan's approval of the exact resource-policy diff.
